source_text: Vidi Deum facie ad faciem et salva facta est anima mea. Ortus solis. Haec Homiliae XIV clausula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: I-saw God face to face and saved made is soul my. Rising of-sun. These of-Homily XIV closing. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[I have seen God face to face, and my soul is saved >> Bible:Genesis 32:30]]. The sun rises. This is Homily XIV’s close. Amen.
